value: Moderators are the средний through which one деление реактор cell/vessel sends neutron flux to another or itself. A moderator line consists of EITHER at most %s collimated moderators with a cell/vessel at one endpoint and a cell/vessel at the other OR at most %s collimated moderators with a cell/vessel at one endpoint and a neutron reflector at the other. Moderators are only considered 'active' if part of a line AND adjacent to at least one functional endpoint cell/vessel. A primed or functional cell/vessel sends flux down the line, either to be accepted by the other cell/vessel or to be sent back by the reflector. The total flux sent is the sum of flux factors of the moderators in the line. This is doubled in the case of reflection, and is multiplied by the reflector's reflectivity factor. Finally, the total efficiency of the cells at the line endpoints is multiplied by the mean efficiency of the lines it receives flux from - the efficiency of a line is the mean efficiency multiplier of the moderators in the line.
